intent: Make facility authoring safe, readable, and easy to operate.
expectations: No new player behavior, persistence shape, or public capability
context: area: frontend/overseer/src and facility browser journeys
constraint: preserve feature 035 private authority and portable session model
approach: Preserve reference data and one explicit draft; present adjacent device details and contextual editable relationships; compare server-resolved previews.

decisions.decision: Retain complete dirty draft and its base revision on session updates
decisions.why: Bindings live outside the facility aggregate and must not be lost
decisions.rejected: Silent merge of only facility definitions

decisions.decision: Edit conditions by cloning the original and overlaying only form-represented scope, category, capability, and private recovery fields.
decisions.why: Dependency navigation must lead to a useful editor without erasing advanced effects, recovery references, runtime flags, or future-compatible fields.
decisions.rejected: Rebuild the condition only from the simplified form.

decisions.decision: Load sessions/demo.json into the existing browser authoring fixture through its revision-checked save endpoint.
decisions.why: This verifies the exact shipped 10-device dataset without adding a second fixture scenario or production-only test path.
decisions.rejected: Treat the smaller synthetic fixture as full-demo visual evidence.

plan.summary: Frontend-only UX improvements with existing private contracts and browser regression gates

tasks.summary: 12 tasks in 10 ordered waves covering all four user stories

specify.summary: Specified four prioritized facility-authoring UX stories and fourteen testable requirements from the feature-035 screenshot and source review.
specify.key_finding: The baseline exposed seven connected UX gaps in draft safety, information hierarchy, relationship maintenance, transition clarity, and consequence preview.
specify.risks: The follow-up must retain feature 035 private-authority and portable-session behavior while changing the authoring surface.

implement.summary: Completed convergence with stale-draft conflict coverage, editable condition/program dependency destinations, missing-target feedback, and responsive visual proof using the actual ten-device demo.
implement.key_finding: All FR-001 through FR-014 and SC-001 through SC-006 now pass with 22 focused and 49 affected browser journeys.
implement.risks: No known residual product risk; one Playwright install preflight stalled only under a PTY and all non-PTY Taskfile validations passed.

T001.did: Added multi-transition reference/recovery preservation, focused incomplete-row validation, explicit staging/save/discard and failed-save retention regressions; targeted browser run reproduces cleared prerequisite device on graph open.

T002.did: Restricted state refresh, retained original entity fields and rejected incomplete references

T003.did: Unified draft staging and explicit publication, retained stale drafts, and guarded live operations

T005.did: Added searchable device details, readable live and initial states, scoped relationships and explicit operation consequences

T004.did: Built responsive searchable device sidebar and adjacent details, persistent session draft actions, readable transition/reference styling, and sticky facility dialog footers; static HTML nesting/unique IDs and diff checks passed.

T006.did: Added binding and recovery-program editing/removal with complete transition lists and retained metadata

T007.did: Made dependency rows readable and navigable to transition, program, condition, node, or block editors; exposed facility actions with readable transition context directly in command editing.

T008.did: Added readable transition summaries, expandable counted rules, explicit activate/remove fault effects, and automatic comparative saved-data previews with changed, hidden, unavailable, and stale-response handling.

T009.did: Expanded browser coverage for preservation, draft publication, responsive and keyboard layout, transition clarity, relationship editing, dependency navigation, command context, comparative preview, and dirty-preview guards; updated legacy authoring expectations.

T010.did: Updated the demo acceptance guide for searchable adjacent details, shared draft apply/save/discard, transition disclosures, relationship maintenance, dependency navigation, command-context actions, automatic comparative previews, and live-operation guards.

T011.did: Completed simplification and integration review; passed 19 focused and 46 affected browser journeys, production frontend builds, repository quality gates, Go tests, native build, and macOS packaging; recorded evidence.

T012.did: Visually compared the implemented facility workspace and dialogs with all eight feature-035 screenshots at 1440x900 and 800x700; confirmed adjacent/stacked responsive layout, sticky graph actions, comparative preview clarity and final FR-001 through FR-014 coverage; recorded evidence and constitution recheck.

T013.did: Added and passed a browser regression proving dirty facility drafts survive newer durable session events, stale saves are rejected without a write, and discard adopts the canonical update.

T014.did: Opened condition dependencies in a safe prefilled editor, preserved unrepresented condition effects/recovery/runtime fields, and added passing coverage for condition, program, and missing dependency destinations.

T015.did: Loaded the actual ten-device demo through the authoring fixture, passed and visually inspected adjacent desktop and overflow-free narrow layouts, and corrected the recorded evidence.
